walkup_orders.detail: Take and manage orders at the window, paid on your own card terminal.

sold_out_toggle.detail: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it grays out for customers right away.

online_ordering_pay_at_hatch.detail: Customers order ahead online and pay in person when they pick up.

time_slot_selection.detail: Customers choose a pickup time slot, spreading demand across your service.

whatsapp_auto_replies.detail: Auto-reply to WhatsApp inquiries about your menu and schedule.

messenger_instagram_replies.detail: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram inquiries.

tap_to_pay.detail: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card reader.

landing.mergedAutoRepliesDetail: Auto-reply to inquiries about your menu and schedule on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram.
